title: Using personalisation makes every AI chat less risky and more effective — here are five essential custom instructions to add
content:
One of best things you can do to lower the risks of using AI and improve the quality of outputs is to spend five minutes with one of AI tools’ least-used features: their personalisation settings.

ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot and Claude all have personalisation features: a section of the tool where you can give it permanent extra information that informs every conversation. You can find it in your general settings under names like ‘instructions’, ‘personal context’ or ‘personalization’, or using the links above.

Here are five instructions you can include in that section:

Your professional role, ethics, location, language, skill level and other details all provide vital context that will help reduce assumptions and misunderstandings and improve the ‘predictions’ that AI tools make when responding.
